# SOURCE : From which culture we convert
# TARGET : To which culture we convert
# FACTOR : Factor (between 0-1) of total adherents to convert
E_kCAFG_convert_province_culture_factor = {
    $SOURCE$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = source_factor
        value = V_kCAFG_province_culture_factor
    }
    $TARGET$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = target_factor
        value = V_kCAFG_province_culture_factor
    }
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = converted_factor
        value = {
            value = $FACTOR$
            min = 0
            max = 1
            max = scope:source_factor
            max = {
                value = 1
                subtract = scope:target_factor
            }
        }
    }
    E_kCAFG_subtract_struct_factor = {
        TYPE = culture
        SCOPE = $SOURCE$
        FACTOR = scope:converted_factor
    }
    E_kCAFG_add_struct_factor = {
        TYPE = culture
        SCOPE = $TARGET$
        FACTOR = scope:converted_factor
    }

    E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = yes
    E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
}

# CULTURE : culture scope
# FACTOR : 0-1 value
E_kCAFG_set_province_culture_factor = {
    E_kCAFG_set_struct_factor = {
        TYPE = culture
        SCOPE = $CULTURE$
        FACTOR = $FACTOR$
    }
    
    E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = yes
}

# CULTURE : culture scope
E_kCAFG_set_maximum_province_culture_factor = {
    E_kCAFG_set_province_culture_factor = {
        CULTURE = $CULTURE$
        FACTOR = 1
    }
}

# CULTURE : culture name
# VALUE : 0-100 value
E_kCAFG_set_province_culture_percentage = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = kCAFG_tmp_factor
        value = {
            value = $VALUE$
            divide = 100
            min = 0
            max = 1
        }
    }
    E_kCAFG_set_province_culture_factor = {
        CULTURE = culture:$CULTURE$
        FACTOR = scope:kCAFG_tmp_factor
    }
}

# Scope : province 
# FACTOR : how much to convert
# CULTURE : culture to convert to
# Doesn't update any county variables
E_kCAFG_province_weighted_culture_conversion = { # Additional people
    E_kCAFG_add_struct_factor = {
        TYPE = culture
        SCOPE = $CULTURE$
        FACTOR = $FACTOR$
    }

    # Normalize
    set_local_variable = {
        name = kCAFG_weighted_conversion_total_factor
        value = {
            value = 1
            add = $FACTOR$
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
        change_variable = { name = factor divide = local_var:kCAFG_weighted_conversion_total_factor }
        E_kCAFG_check_struct_removal = { TYPE = culture }
    }

    E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
    E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = yes
}

# Scope : province 
# FACTOR : how much to convert
# CULTURE : culture to convert to
# Doesn't update any county variables
E_kCAFG_province_weighted_culture_deconversion = { # People leave
    if = {
        limit = {
            T_kCAFG_province_cultures_count_at_least = { VALUE = 2 } # No point in doing that if there is only one culture
            T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_culture = { CULTURE = $CULTURE$ }
        }
        
        every_in_list = {
            variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
            limit = { this.var:culture = $CULTURE$ }
            save_temporary_scope_as = struct
        }

        set_local_variable = {
            name = kCAFG_final_factor
            value = {
                value = $FACTOR$
                max = scope:struct.var:factor
            }
        }

        # Normalize
        every_in_list = {
            variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
            limit = { this.var:culture != $CULTURE$ }
            change_variable = {
                name = factor
                add = {
                    value = local_var:kCAFG_final_factor
                    multiply = var:factor
                    divide = {
                        value = 1
                        subtract = scope:struct.var:factor
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        E_kCAFG_subtract_struct_factor = {
            TYPE = culture
            SCOPE = $CULTURE$
            FACTOR = local_var:kCAFG_final_factor
        }

        E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
        E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = yes
    }
}

# Scope : province 
# FACTOR : how much to convert
# CULTURE : culture to convert to
# Doesn't update any county variables
E_kCAFG_province_dynamic_weighted_culture_conversion = { # Additional people
    $CULTURE$ = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_converting_culture } # used by V_kCAFG_province_culture_conversion_weight
    if = {
        limit = {
		    has_global_variable = kCAFG_is_loaded_v2
            any_in_list = {
                variable = kCAFG_province_cultures
                scope:kCAFG_converting_culture != this
            }
        }

        E_kCAFG_add_struct_factor = {
            TYPE = culture
            SCOPE = scope:kCAFG_converting_culture
            FACTOR = $FACTOR$
        }

        # Normalize
        set_local_variable = {
            name = kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor
            value = $FACTOR$
        }
        save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_converted_province # used by V_kCAFG_province_culture_conversion_weight
        while = {
            limit = {
                local_var:kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor > 0
                any_in_list = {
                    variable = kCAFG_province_cultures
                    scope:kCAFG_converting_culture != this
                }
            }

            # Transfer culture
            random_in_list = {
                variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
                limit = { scope:kCAFG_converting_culture != var:culture }

                weight = {
                    base = 0
                    modifier = { add = var:culture.V_kCAFG_province_culture_conversion_weight }
                }

                save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
                    name = converted_factor
                    value = {
                        value = V_kCAFG_smallest_minority_factor
                        max = var:factor
                        max = local_var:kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor
                    }
                }

                if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:converted_factor > 0
                    }

                    var:culture = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_converted_culture }

                    scope:kCAFG_converted_province = {
                        E_kCAFG_subtract_struct_factor = {
                            TYPE = culture
                            SCOPE = scope:kCAFG_converted_culture
                            FACTOR = scope:converted_factor
                        }
                    }

                    change_local_variable = {
                        name = kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor
                        subtract = scope:converted_factor
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        # Excess
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_local_variable = kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor
                local_var:kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor > 0
            }
            E_kCAFG_subtract_struct_factor = {
                TYPE = culture
                SCOPE = scope:kCAFG_converting_culture
                FACTOR = local_var:kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor
            }
        }
        remove_local_variable = kCAFG_weighted_conversion_remaining_factor

        E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
        E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = yes
    }
}

# Scope : province 
# FACTOR : base factor conversion
# VARIANCE : randomization added to the base factor
# CULTURE : culture to convert to
# MAX : maximum converted factor (i.e. keep minorities)
# Doesn't update any county variables
E_kCAFG_province_randomized_weighted_culture_conversion = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
        name = randomized_factor_to_convert
        value = {
            fixed_range = {
                min = {
                    value = $FACTOR$
                    subtract = {
                        fixed_range = {
                            min = 0
                            max = $VARIANCE$
                        }
                    }
                    min = 0
                }
                max = {
                    value = $FACTOR$
                    add = {
                        fixed_range = {
                            min = 0
                            max = $VARIANCE$
                        }
                    }
                    max = 1
                }
            }
            min = 0

            max = {
                value = {
                    value = {
                        value = $MAX$
                        min = 0
                        max = 1
                    }
                }
                $CULTURE$ = { prev = { subtract = V_kCAFG_province_prev_culture_factor } }
            }
        }
    }

    E_kCAFG_province_dynamic_weighted_culture_conversion = {
        FACTOR = scope:randomized_factor_to_convert
        CULTURE = $CULTURE$
    }
}

E_kCAFG_clear_all_province_cultures = {
	clear_variable_list = kCAFG_province_cultures
	clear_variable_list = kCAFG_province_culture_structs

    E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = yes
}

# Used to update UI if we're looking at the scoped province
# Scope : province
E_kCAFG_check_request_culture_UI_update = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = kCAFG_culture_UI_update_requested }
            is_target_in_global_variable_list = {
                name = kCAFG_UI_viewed_provinces
                target = this
            }
        }
        set_variable = kCAFG_culture_UI_update_requested
    }
}

# Scope : Province
# SAVED_SCOPE
E_kCAFG_get_random_culture_from_this_province = {
    random_in_list = {
        variable = kCAFG_province_culture_structs
        weight = {
            base = 0
            modifier = { add = { value = var:factor multiply = 10000 } }
        }
        var:culture = { save_scope_as = $SAVED_SCOPE$ }
    }
}

# PROVINCE
# SAVED_SCOPE
E_kCAFG_get_random_culture_from_province = {
    $PROVINCE$ = {
        E_kCAFG_get_random_culture_from_this_province = { SAVED_SCOPE = $SAVED_SCOPE$ }
    }
}
